deployments_detail.use: AI Help — assistive feature built on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that gives users instant guidance and documentation summaries grounded in trusted Planisware documentation. Generally available. [Planisware (RAG over enterprise LLM)]
Prisma hybrid-reasoning AI agent to automate project portfolio management and resource allocation

Oscar — agentic AI assistant embedded in Planisware Enterprise that enables natural-language interaction with project/portfolio data. An orchestration agent coordinates specialized sub-agents for forecasting, risk scoring and resource optimization, and can plan and execute multi-step workflows. Generally available (recommend v7.1.5+). [Planisware (customer's enterprise LLM, provider-agnostic)]

LLM Connector — lets customers connect any commercial or proprietary LLM (explicitly names OpenAI, Copilot, Le Chat, or a custom-trained model) to power generative AI in the Planisware Assistant and AI Help features with minimal technical overhead. [Planisware; OpenAI / Microsoft Copilot / Mistral Le Chat (customer-selectable)]

Generative AI — produces project data in seconds including comprehensive work breakdown structures, schedules and risk assessments, accelerating project definition. Generally available in Planisware Enterprise. [Planisware]

Predictive Analytics — machine-learning (gradient-boosted regression trees) that analyzes historical data to forecast task durations, resource demand, costs, project outcomes, benchmark KPIs and bid win-likelihood. Generally available for Planisware Enterprise v6.3+ (confidence ranges in v7.1.5+). [Planisware (gradient-boosted regression trees)]

Swarm Intelligence / Particle Swarm Optimization — nature-inspired optimization that dynamically evaluates millions of potential resource combinations to identify the most efficient portfolio resource distribution. Embedded in Planisware's PPM/SPM solutions. [Planisware (particle swarm optimization)]

MCP Connector — Planisware implements the Model Context Protocol so its AI agent Oscar becomes a cross-platform, context-aware agent that securely connects to enterprise systems (e.g. Salesforce, Microsoft Teams, CRM) and other MCP-compatible agents. Available for all customers in version 26Q2 and above. [Planisware (Model Context Protocol / Anthropic open standard)]

Data Quality Audit / Anomaly Detection — AI that identifies data integrity issues and anomalies in project schedules in real time using DCMA standards or custom rules, surfacing hidden trends analysts might miss. Available in Planisware solutions. [Planisware]
